hook: Infosys opens *1.1 million sq ft* block, eyes *13,000* more staff in Hyderabad
hook_b: Infosys Hyderabad adds 13,000 jobs? What should the city fix next?
tldr: Infosys inaugurated a 1.1 million sq ft block at its Pocharam centre in Hyderabad and is eyeing 13,000 more employees.

beats.what: On Oct 30 Infosys announced the expansion of its Pocharam Development Centre with a new 1.1 million sq ft Software Development Block.
beats.why: Hyderabad keeps pulling big IT employers. The report says Infosys eyes 13,000 more employees here.
beats.care: More jobs mean more people on the IT corridor, from homes to roads. Fresher hiring details were not in the report.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat reports the Pocharam DC expansion and the inauguration of the 1.1 million sq ft block on Oct 30. Hiring timelines and fresher share were not stated.

cards.q: More big IT campuses are coming. What should Hyderabad fix first?
opts: Metro and roads to IT areas

learn.t: DC means Development Centre, an Indian base where a company builds software for global clients.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: Infosys expands Hyderabad campus, eyes 13,000 more employees
